Nava Raipur textile park gets garment unit, boosting Chhattisgarh's manufacturing

The Nava Raipur textile park in Chhattisgarh has received its first garment unit, which is expected to boost the state's manufacturing sector. The development comes after years of efforts by the government and private investors to establish a major textile hub in the region. This move is seen as a significant step towards promoting industrial growth and creating employment opportunities in Chhattisgarh.
